info.title: WeaveOS Authentication and Personnel API
info.description: Product version v0.1.0; public compatibility path /api/v1. Browser session authentication follows ADR-001. This contract does not define general RBAC or cross-service RPC. Q25 / accepted ADR006 add personnel administration and a scoped page-based pagination exception. Q36 approved execution source: docs/tasks/V010-020-PLAN.md. New contracts are frozen before implementation; phase-A schema/contract passing is not runtime acceptance.

post.description: Requires an allowed same-origin Origin. Missing Origin requires a verified same-origin Referer or a suitable CSRF proof. Only application/json is accepted. Account is trimmed at both ends; case is preserved and internal spaces are rejected. Registration never creates a Session. Invitation consumption and account creation are atomic.

account.description: Trim leading/trailing ordinary ASCII spaces (U+0020); normalized length is 1–254 Unicode code points, reject internal ordinary spaces/control characters and preserve case. Alice and alice are distinct accounts.

password.description: Q13: only printable ASCII U+0020–U+007E; at least one uppercase A–Z, lowercase a–z, digit 0–9 and visible ASCII punctuation. Ordinary spaces are allowed but do not count as special; no trimming or extra length floor.

invitationCode.description: Validated and consumed once by the server; never recorded in ordinary logs.

post.summary: Log in with account and password
post.description: Requires the same Origin/CSRF and JSON media policy as registration. Unknown account, wrong password and Disabled account share the public invalid-credentials result. A successful login creates a fresh random server-side Redis Session with one-hour idle TTL and an HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie. Login JSON does not return csrfToken; the independent token is delivered only in the frontend-readable __Host-csrf Cookie.

account.description: Trim leading/trailing ordinary ASCII spaces (U+0020); normalized length is 1–254 Unicode code points, reject internal ordinary spaces/control characters and preserve case. Alice and alice are distinct accounts.

Set-Cookie.description: Two separate Set-Cookie fields: __Host-session with Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=3600, and __Host-csrf with Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=3600 (non-HttpOnly). Neither sets Domain.

get.description: Successful authenticated activity renews the Redis idle TTL to one hour and synchronizes browser cookie lifetime. Identity is checked from the server-side Session and current user state.

head.summary: Check current Session without a response body

401.description: Unauthenticated; no body

503.description: Session cannot be verified; no body

delete.description: Requires an allowed same-origin Origin, verified Referer or appropriate CSRF proof. Deletes the server-side Session before reporting success; concurrent renewal cannot recreate it. Browser cookie is expired.

Set-Cookie.description: Expire both __Host-session and __Host-csrf using separate Set-Cookie fields and their original security attributes.

post.summary: A qualified personnel manager creates a one-use invitation
post.description: Only the current personnel.manage-qualified account may create an invitation. A generated code has no time expiry and is displayed once. Requires same-origin/CSRF proof and application/json body. Qualification is live personnel.manage; existing invitation ownership, atomic consumption and secrecy remain unchanged. Optional queryVersion guards invocation from the member table; existing non-table invocation still rechecks current permission. Invitation material is never saved in a draft.

post.summary: Bootstrap Admin resets a user's password
post.description: Only the current Bootstrap Admin may reset. The new password is the PRD-mandated fixed value and is never returned or logged. Existing Sessions for the target are invalidated under the approved data-design revision. Requires same-origin/CSRF proof and application/json body.

200.description: Password reset, without password in body

get.description: Requires live personnel.manage. Consistent live authorization; no cross-request cache.

put.description: Requires live personnel.manage. Transaction rechecks current Session account/version and qualification, holds actual authorization dependency locks, writes configuration and safe audit atomically. Stale version/reference/deadlock conflict returns 409 without automatic replay.  Q36: query-guarded member/department writes prevalidate full old query in short RR OUTSIDE revision write locks. RC write transaction locks needed revisions people/configuration/activity in fixed order, reauthorizes with existing account/auth_version and dependency locks, verifies observed revisions, checks object version, then mutates/audits. A changed observed revision restarts prevalidation (maximum two extra attempts); not automatically QUERY_CHANGED. Identity/template card writes keep object checks and only invalidate dependent datasets. Optional draftRef cleanup is conditional and atomic with successful business write.

get.description: Live personnel.manage and Session required for every access, including restore. Owner from Session; other owners return PERSONNEL_NOT_FOUND after authorization. Drafts survive reload/browser close and have no expiry; saving does not change business data, audit or query revisions. Restore separately reads current target, keeps original baseVersion and inputs; never auto-recreates deleted targets or overwrites newer object/draft versions. List order updated_at DESC,id DESC.

requestBody.description: Route-local entire raw JSON body <=131072 bytes AND canonical payload <=65536 bytes. Both must hold. Normal JSON.stringify UTF-8 payload plus wrapper fits; excessive Unicode escapes or whitespace may exceed the raw bound and must be rejected even when canonical payload fits. No global body/header limit change.

post.description: Read-only POST; no business writes, business audit events or dataset revision increments. May create/touch bounded Redis query contexts. Live Session, source/CSRF checks remain required despite read semantics. Requires live personnel.manage. Consistent live authorization; no cross-request cache.  Q36: filter/sort the complete live result before page/offset. Check old baseline, establish new criteria, total/page/revision in ONE short REPEATABLE READ transaction. Revision is only the unchanged fast path; changed revision requires complete safe projection SHA256, excluding object version. Equal fingerprints including ABA are allowed. Never return mixed snapshots or auto-clamp a stale page. Invalid page/pageSize is 400; retain existing valid-page behavior for an empty result. Only numeric/time sorts; members accept no sort parameters. Query metadata is not a historical data snapshot.

get.description: B5a frozen limited vertical slice. Live Session, current active account/auth_version; no query parameters. Application entry is fixed owner/Bootstrap or current same-app member plus enabled group menu.enter grant, with actual registered/enabled catalog and menu resource; no second central identity/template entry grant. Group configuration is fixed owner or Bootstrap only.

400.description: COMMON_INVALID_ARGUMENT or APPLICATION_RESOURCE_INVALID

401.description: AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED

403.description: COMMON_CSRF_REJECTED or APPLICATION_FORBIDDEN

404.description: APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND; operation absence does not prove rollback

503.description: APPLICATION_OPERATION_UNCONFIRMED if COMMIT acknowledgement is lost; otherwise COMMON_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

409.description: AUTH_SESSION_CHANGED: authenticated actor differs from expected actor; no business access or operation claim/replay

post.description: B5a frozen limited vertical slice. Live Session, current active account/auth_version; no query parameters. Application entry is fixed owner/Bootstrap or current same-app member plus enabled group menu.enter grant, with actual registered/enabled catalog and menu resource; no second central identity/template entry grant. Group configuration is fixed owner or Bootstrap only. Writes require trusted Origin/CSRF and strict JSON with no duplicate/unknown fields at any nesting level, maximum 1 MiB. Every write binds actor+operationId to actual operation/method/route+normalized DTO, including original expectedPolicyRevision. Identical replay returns original result/status/Location without another revision or audit; conflicting reuse is 409. New policy writes CAS then increment policyRevision once, even identical replacements. Config, safe audit and operation result commit together. No success before COMMIT acknowledgement. Unconfirmed 503 requires querying/retrying the original key only; never automatically use a fresh key. Confirmed write remains successful if Session renewal fails; browser cookies are cleared. Requires live applications.create (personnel-managed direct/template capability) or Bootstrap; server UUID and trusted actor as immutable owner. Atomic app + revision1 + true application workspace menu + catalog + result + audit.

summary.description: Safe allowlisted configuration changes only; never authentication or invitation material.

QueryVersion.description: Opaque Redis query context identifier owned by the current Session. Idle TTL 30 minutes; 20 per Session, LRU. No result rows/ID list; missing/expired/evicted is COMMON_QUERY_CONTEXT_EXPIRED, not QUERY_CHANGED.

QueryRange.description: Effective absolute half-open [from,to) range. Default last seven days is fixed for this context; explicit refresh resolves it again.

CalendarDateValue.description: Valid calendar date and supported IANA zone; server resolves actual local-day [start,nextStart), including DST. eq=inside, neq=outside; gt>=nextStart, gte>=start, lt<start, lte<nextStart. Do not assume 24h.

oneOf.description: Exact case-sensitive text. Ordinary comparisons exclude SQL NULL; null value eq/neq means IS NULL/IS NOT NULL.
Controlled status enum; ordinary comparisons exclude NULL.
eq=EXISTS this UUID; neq=NOT EXISTS this UUID. Empty relationship set satisfies neq. No relation-null operand.
Effective permission shown in the member column; live Bootstrap qualification and account status rules remain in force.

MemberFilterCondition.description: Allowlisted typed leaf. NULL never matches an ordinary comparison; explicit value:null only eq/neq. No SQL, arbitrary fields, text inequalities or numeric enum ranking.

MemberFilterGroupLevel3.description: Grouped predicate; root depth is 1. All leaves across the tree count toward 20; whole canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. No DNF expansion; empty group invalid. Existing shortcut/search predicates AND the whole tree.

MemberFilterGroupLevel2.description: Grouped predicate; root depth is 1. All leaves across the tree count toward 20; whole canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. No DNF expansion; empty group invalid. Existing shortcut/search predicates AND the whole tree.

MemberFilterGroup.description: Grouped predicate; root depth is 1. All leaves across the tree count toward 20; whole canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. No DNF expansion; empty group invalid. Existing shortcut/search predicates AND the whole tree.

oneOf.description: Compare server-owned safe display text exactly, case-sensitive; ordinary comparisons exclude SQL NULL.
Controlled raw action code, UI label does not become a SQL field.
Controlled raw outcome; safe display still groups failure/error as failure.
Absolute instant (RFC3339, at most microsecond precision) or explicit calendar day; null only eq/neq.
Non-null instant or calendar day; ordinary comparisons exclude NULL. Reject invalid dates/zones and lossy sub-microsecond input.

EventFilterCondition.description: Allowlisted typed leaf. NULL never matches an ordinary comparison; explicit value:null only eq/neq. No SQL, arbitrary fields, text inequalities or numeric enum ranking.

EventFilterGroupLevel3.description: Grouped predicate; root depth is 1. All leaves across the tree count toward 20; whole canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. No DNF expansion; empty group invalid. Existing shortcut/search predicates AND the whole tree.

EventFilterGroupLevel2.description: Grouped predicate; root depth is 1. All leaves across the tree count toward 20; whole canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. No DNF expansion; empty group invalid. Existing shortcut/search predicates AND the whole tree.

ActivityDisplay.description: Server-owned safe display values; resolve against full allowed data, never the current member page. No secrets or arbitrary audit columns.

DraftReference.description: Acknowledge only this owner-owned draft revision after successful business commit; preserve a concurrently newer revision. Never delete on failed/ambiguous business write.

DraftPayload.description: Explicit editable field allowlist only; canonical UTF-8 JSON <=65536 bytes. Empty/incomplete input and now-invalid reference IDs may be saved. No credentials, invitation plaintext, Session, full query rows or arbitrary metadata. Validate payload variant against persisted kind on update.

DraftCreateInput.description: Owner comes only from Session. targetId/baseVersion null only for new department/identity/template; existing definition/department baseVersion>=1, member baseVersion>=0. Immutable kind/target/original baseVersion. No automatic expiration. Maximum 20 per owner; exceeding capacity returns PERSONNEL_DRAFT_LIMIT_REACHED, never evicts.

DraftUpdateInput.description: Owner and live personnel.manage required. CAS draft version; do not rebase original baseVersion. Only explicit inputs are replaced, never silently merge tabs.

MemberSearchInput.description: Read-only typed search body. filter is an object, never a URL-encoded string. Canonical filter UTF-8 <=16384 bytes and raw entire body <=65536 bytes independently; standard escaped Unicode/date JSON is accepted within both limits. First query/explicit refresh starts page 1 without queryVersion; continue or change criteria using the previous context. Defaults are existing page=1,pageSize=20; default event range last seven days is fixed until explicit refresh.

EventSearchInput.description: Read-only typed search body. filter is an object, never a URL-encoded string. Canonical filter UTF-8 <=16384 bytes and raw entire body <=65536 bytes independently; standard escaped Unicode/date JSON is accepted within both limits. First query/explicit refresh starts page 1 without queryVersion; continue or change criteria using the previous context. Defaults are existing page=1,pageSize=20; default event range last seven days is fixed until explicit refresh.

TablePresetMemberFilter.description: Editable AND rows / OR blocks only; no empty groups or DNF conversion. Global leaf count <=20; canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. Query AST and typed semantics are unchanged.

TablePresetEventFilter.description: Editable AND rows / OR blocks only; no empty groups or DNF conversion. Global leaf count <=20; canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes. Query AST and typed semantics are unchanged.

name.description: Trim surrounding whitespace, count Unicode characters, retain exact case. Unique per Session owner and view.

hiddenColumnIds.description: Stable configurable business column IDs only. Validate against immutable view; at least one business column stays visible. Display only, never a query projection/permission input.

TablePresetCreateInput.description: Independent raw body <=65536 UTF-8 bytes, canonical configuration <=32768 bytes, filter <=16384 bytes. Missing/null filter means visibility-only. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected; no owner or queryVersion. PUT retains view and uses version CAS.

name.description: Trim surrounding whitespace, count Unicode characters, retain exact case. Unique per Session owner and view.

hiddenColumnIds.description: Stable configurable business column IDs only. Validate against immutable view; at least one business column stays visible. Display only, never a query projection/permission input.

TablePresetUpdateInput.description: Independent raw body <=65536 UTF-8 bytes, canonical configuration <=32768 bytes, filter <=16384 bytes. Missing/null filter means visibility-only. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected; no owner or queryVersion. PUT retains view and uses version CAS.

name.description: Trim surrounding whitespace, count Unicode characters, retain exact case. Unique per Session owner and view.

hiddenColumnIds.description: Stable configurable business column IDs only. Validate against immutable view; at least one business column stays visible. Display only, never a query projection/permission input.

name.description: TrimSpace normalization; 1–100 Unicode code points after trimming. Names need not be unique. NUL is invalid because PostgreSQL text cannot store it.
TrimSpace normalization; 1–100 Unicode code points after trimming. Names need not be unique. NUL is invalid because PostgreSQL text cannot store it.

memberIds.description: Required non-null list; [] clears. UUIDs must identify existing users; inactive users confer no access.

grants.description: Required non-null full replacement. Only actual same-app workspace menu resources; no data grants or fields registry in B5a.

DecimalConfigInput.description: Only omission selects defaults: precision38, scale money2/number0, roundingPlaces=normalized scale, HALF_UP. scale<=precision and roundingPlaces<=scale. Null and unknown keys reject.

displayTimeZone.description: datetime only; omitted/null normalizes to UTC; valid IANA zone
datetime only; omitted/null normalizes to UTC; valid IANA zone

FieldInput.description: Stable field UUID, exact constant defaults only; readonly system columns excluded. Numeric wire/default values are decimal strings. Business rows are typed PostgreSQL columns.

Field.description: Stable field UUID, exact constant defaults only; readonly system columns excluded. Numeric wire/default values are decimal strings. Business rows are typed PostgreSQL columns.

LayoutNodeInput.description: Stable node IDs; arrays define order; each group has its own 12-column grid. Description/divider full width; no SQL columns.

LayoutNode.description: Stable node IDs; arrays define order; each group has its own 12-column grid. Description/divider full width; no SQL columns.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, invalid invitation, or field validation

Forbidden.description: CSRF rejection or required trusted Root/personnel.manage qualification denied

Conflict.description: Account already exists or invitation already used

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Only application/json is accepted for credential writes

Unavailable.description: A required authentication dependency cannot be verified

InternalError.description: Internal error with safe public detail only

PersonnelConflict.description: Stale configuration version, referenced/protected deletion, or serialization/deadlock conflict. PERSONNEL_CONFLICT.

QueryConflict.description: COMMON_QUERY_CHANGED: current full related result differs; explicit refresh required. COMMON_QUERY_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: missing/idle-expired/evicted/foreign-session context, restart query; no claim that data changed. Existing object conflict stays PERSONNEL_CONFLICT.

QueryUnavailable.description: COMMON_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; meta.reason=QUERY_BUSY distinguishes exhausted prevalidation retries from dependency failure. At most two additional prevalidations within request deadline; never replay executed writes.

DraftConflict.description: PERSONNEL_DRAFT_CONFLICT for stale draft version; PERSONNEL_DRAFT_LIMIT_REACHED at 20 drafts. No silent overwrite or eviction. Payload >64KiB is COMMON_INVALID_ARGUMENT (400).

TablePresetConflict.description: Independent exact-name, owner/view 20-slot limit, or stale version conflict; preserve inputs and never overwrite/evict.

CsrfToken.description: Must equal the canonical __Host-csrf Cookie value, match its server-side Session hash binding, and pass trusted Origin checks.
CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

ExpectedActor.name: X-Expected-Actor-Id
ExpectedActor.description: Task ADR appendix B. New application clients must send the verified actor bound to view/operation. Only a negative constraint: real Session still supplies identity and permission; mismatch409 AUTH_SESSION_CHANGED before business read/write/claim/replay. Malformed400 COMMON_VALIDATION_FAILED. Absence preserves legacy compatibility.
